subject: Private Offer request - LumaProd: rev-share + upfront credit (exec escalation)
messages:
From: Alyssa Moreno <alyssa.moreno@lumaprod.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private Offer request - LumaProd (rev-share + upfront credit)

Hi Neha,

Thanks for jumping on the call yesterday. Per our procurement team's ask I wanted to document LumaProd's position and the rationale so you have it in one place. We're evaluating Redwood for inference across our new recommendation service (APAC rollout) and have a couple of constraints:

- We need a marketplace private offer (GCP) to use existing procurement flows.
- To align economics with our procurement model we need a 35% rev-share to our marketplace partner and an upfront credit (one-time) of $150k applied against the first quarter of usage.
- We can commit to a 12‑month minimum consumption of $1.2M USD if we get the above terms and a 30‑day net payment discount (net30).

Attachments: LumaProd_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW), revshare_model_v2.xlsx (our internal model), PO draft.

We know this is outside standard marketplace splits — the ask is commercial (rev-share) + an operational credit to offset migration cost. Hoping you can route this to Deal Desk / Exec for expedited review; timing is tight as our CFO wants commercial terms confirmed by next Friday (10/09).

Happy to provide more detail.

Best,
Alyssa
Head of Partnerships, LumaProd

+61 4 11 222 333

Karthik / Deal Desk,

Forwarding LumaProd's formal request — they are a strategic APAC customer (retail recommendation) and offered a 12‑month committed spend if we can make the economics work. Key items: 35% rev-share to their partner path, one-time $150k upfront credit, net30 payments.

Can you confirm feasibility and suggested counter (if any)? Also flag any legal/compliance blockers for a marketplace private offer in APAC with a nonstandard rev-share. They need an answer by COB 10/09.

Attachments included above.

Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Private Offer request - LumaProd (rev-share + upfront credit)

Neha — thanks for routing. Quick analysis after reviewing attached model and SOW:

Summary:
- 35% rev-share is aggressive for marketplace splits; our typical floor for partner rev-share is 20–25% depending on channel. A one-off 35% would materially impact Redwood's unit economics unless constrained to first 3 months or linked to an MWSP/commitment.
- $150k upfront credit is workable if applied as a usage credit spread over first 3 billing cycles with a min commitment (their $1.2M annual spend).
- Net30 is standard and acceptable.

Recommended counter (Deal Desk lens):
- Approve a time-limited rev-share uplift to 33% for the first 90 days of revenue generated through the private offer, reverting to 25% thereafter.
- Apply the $150k as a usage credit (non-refundable), staggered across first 3 invoices.
- Require a signed 12‑month commitment (minimum $1.2M) + PO before private offer is activated.
- Legal to review a narrow carve-out in the marketplace listing to ensure partner rev-share routing is auditable.

Finance impact: at our forecasted consumption (from their model) the proposed counter keeps LTV acceptable; full 35% indefinitely would drop margin below threshold.

If Marketing/Sales leadership is comfortable with 33% intro + $150k credit amortized, we can present to Exec for sign-off.

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Manager, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer request - LumaProd (rev-share + upfront credit)

Neha / Karthik — I reviewed Karthik's recommendation and the ask from LumaProd. Given the strategic APAC expansion and the size of the commitment, I'm comfortable escalating this to Exec with the following proposed final terms:

- Intro rev-share: 33% for first 90 days, then 25% standard split.
- $150k upfront credit applied as a one-time invoice credit across first three invoices.
- 12‑month commitment (min $1.2M) + PO required prior to private offer activation.
- Net30 payment terms.

Requesting Exec approval for the above. If approved, Legal to prepare a short addendum to the private offer specifying rev-share routing and audit rights.

Marissa Cole
VP Sales — Cloud Partners
Redwood Inference

Hi Alyssa — quick update and proposed next steps.

Thanks for the patience while we ran this through Deal Desk and Sales leadership. We have a proposed set of terms we would like to present to your CFO:

- Rev-share: 33% for the first 90 days of revenue tied to the private offer; reverts to 25% thereafter.
- Upfront credit: $150k applied as credit across the first three invoices (non-refundable).
- Commitment: 12 months, minimum $1.2M USD annual consumption.
- Payment: Net30.

If LumaProd is OK with these terms we will route to Exec for formal sign-off and get Legal to prepare the private offer addendum. Attached is a marked PO draft for your review (LumaProd_PO_draft.pdf). Also linking to the HubSpot deal for the paperwork: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DEAL-LUMA-2026-74

Next steps:
1) Confirm acceptance of proposed terms by EOD Monday 10/12.
2) Provide signed PO (PDF) and preferred billing contact.
3) We will open a DocuSign envelope for the private offer and addendum once Exec signs off.

Appreciate the partnership — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
